author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Its time to take apart the new Steam Machine - what did they hide inside? Grab one of our X-Ray Skins for your devices here: https://dbrand.com/shop/skins/steam-machine-skins

The steam machine is actually surprisingly repairable and upgradable. Adding a 2nd stick of 16gb ram should be an easy no-brainer for anyone who has an extra laying around. 

Would you upgrade your steam machine? What games would you play first on your own Steam Machine?
title: Steam Machine Teardown - My Grandma is Confused...
